body: This will throw if `user` is null — the lookup can return null for guest users but the code doesn't guard against it.
I'd prefer arrow functions throughout this module for consistency. Named function declarations feel out of place given the rest of the codebase.
Why use a Map here rather than a plain object? Curious if there's a specific reason or if it's just preference.
The `buildCacheKey` function is doing too much. I'd split it into a separate normalizer and a formatter so each function has a single responsibility.
Minor typo in the parameter description: 'retunrs' should be 'returns'.
There are no tests covering the guest-user path through session lookup. This is a new code path and should have coverage.
